title: Michael B. Jordan's 'The Thomas Crown Affair' Trailer Drops: The Art Thief Returns March 5, 2027
excerpt: Amazon MGM released the full official trailer for Michael B. Jordan's 'The Thomas Crown Affair' on Thursday. The billionaire art thief returns to theaters March 5, 2027.
content:
Amazon MGM Studios released the full official trailer for The Thomas Crown Affair on Thursday, November 12, with Michael B. Jordan directing, producing and starring as the billionaire art thief at the center of the classic heist story. The film opens only in theaters on March 5, 2027.

The trailer premiered Thursday morning on TODAY, and quickly spread across entertainment outlets as the first full look at Jordan's reimagining, following an earlier teaser and a first look shown at CinemaCon.

A third take on a classic

The film is the third screen version of the story. The 1968 original starred Steve McQueen and Faye Dunaway; the 1999 remake starred Pierce Brosnan. Jordan's version is written by Drew Pearce (The Fall Guy) and Jason Hall (American Sniper).

Jordan's Thomas Crown is a smooth-talking billionaire who slips in and out of high-security buildings and across glamorous locations around the world. Adria Arjona plays the razor-sharp investigator hunting him, and the trailer leans into the cat-and-mouse romance between the two. The cast also includes Kenneth Branagh, Lily Gladstone, Danai Gurira and Pilou Asbæk.

Amazon MGM describes the film as a “visually breathtaking, sensual, and unexpectedly moving heist thriller, where the most dangerous man in the room is the one nobody’s watching.” The film is rated PG-13 for violence and action, some sexuality, nudity, strong language and smoking.

A decade in the making

Jordan has been attached to the project for more than a decade, and this is his second film as a director, following Creed III. The trailer also frames Crown's heist as an act of revenge.

What it means

Analysis: Jordan is coming off Sinners, one of 2026's biggest hits, and the March 5 date plants the film in the early-spring window where a stylish adult thriller can own the conversation. The question is whether a third Crown can justify itself — the trailer's answer is glamour, globe-trotting and Jordan's star power.

For moviegoers in Laredo and the 956, the wait is just under four months: March 5, 2027, in theaters only.
